from build123d import *
from b123d.domain import bolt_circle

# ---- Parameters (mm) ----
outer_d = 85.0          # overall barrel/fin outside diameter
height = 130.0          # total barrel height (incl. flange at top)
bore_d = 62.0           # through bore diameter
core_d = 70.0           # base tube (un-finned) outside diameter
fin_count = 8           # number of cooling fins
fin_thickness = 2.5     # axial thickness of each fin
fin_gap = 6.0           # axial gap between adjacent fins
flange_d = 100.0        # head flange diameter
flange_t = 8.0          # head flange thickness
stud_hole_d = 7.0       # stud clearance hole diameter
bolt_circle_d = 88.0    # stud bolt circle diameter
stud_count = 4          # number of stud holes

# ---- Derived layout (centred coordinates) ----
z_bottom = -height / 2
z_top = height / 2

core_height = height - flange_t
core_center_z = z_bottom + core_height / 2

flange_center_z = z_top - flange_t / 2
flange_bottom_z = z_top - flange_t  # top surface of fin stack area

fin_radius = outer_d / 2
core_radius = core_d / 2
pitch = fin_thickness + fin_gap

# ---- Base tube ----
body = Pos(0, 0, core_center_z) * Cylinder(radius=core_radius, height=core_height)

# ---- Cooling fins (solid discs union'd onto the tube) ----
for i in range(fin_count):
    top_i = flange_bottom_z - i * pitch
    center_i = top_i - fin_thickness / 2
    body += Pos(0, 0, center_i) * Cylinder(radius=fin_radius, height=fin_thickness)

# ---- Head flange ----
body += Pos(0, 0, flange_center_z) * Cylinder(radius=flange_d / 2, height=flange_t)

# ---- Through bore (fully pierces the whole part) ----
body -= Cylinder(radius=bore_d / 2, height=height * 2)

# ---- Stud holes on bolt circle through the flange ----
body -= Pos(0, 0, z_top) * bolt_circle(stud_count, bolt_circle_d, stud_hole_d, flange_t * 2)

result = body

body_d          = 80.0     # root diameter of the finned barrel body
barrel_height   = 145.0    # overall barrel height

fin_thickness   = 3.0
fin_gap         = 5.0
